meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 装好后，你在构建或改动 UI 之后，它会先截图取证（网页、终端 TUI、分页文档），跑脚本算出差异比例，再并行派两个只读子代理复核，最后给出一个通过与否的判定。
howto.when: 当你完成或改动任何 UI 想确认效果，或问某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来对不对时触发；没有渲染输出（纯后端逻辑）时跳过。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做视觉 QA，和参考图对比一下
say.note: 会截图并用脚本算差异比例

say.text: 这个终端界面有没有溢出或者边框错位？
say.note: 走终端宽度检查，列出溢出行

say.text: 把这份 PDF 每一页都截图核一遍
say.note: 逐页渲染成图后再判定

howto.what_en: After you build or change any UI, it captures screenshot evidence (web, TUI, paginated docs), runs a script diff, dispatches two read-only reviewers in parallel, then returns a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skips when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Visual QA this page against the reference mock
say_en.note: Captures screenshots and runs the image diff

say_en.text: Does this TUI overflow or break its borders?
Render and check every page of this PDF
say_en.note: Each page is captured to an image
